units.title: Worldseed indie-game UI: readable fonts, centered dialog, full-screen background

Verify: Base typography and backdrop CSS unit tests

tests.name: base rules
tests.title: base typography and backdrop CSS: body uses the ink background and parchment text at 20px, headings use the pixel font, and the dialog and fullscreen backdrop classes exist
tests.scenario: Given src/styles.css, When it is read, Then the base body, heading and backdrop/dialog rules are present
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/baseTypography.test.ts --testTimeout=20000

units.title: Verify: IntroScreen backdrop and centered dialog unit tests

tests.id: introScreen.test.tsx::IntroScreen styled::renders a full-screen backdrop section
tests.name: IntroScreen styled renders a full-screen backdrop section
tests.title: renders a full-screen backdrop section
tests.scenario: Given the IntroScreen is rendered, when its container is inspected, then the root section carries the sf-fullscreen-bg class
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/introScreen.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: introScreen.test.tsx::IntroScreen styled::shows the intro dialog as a centered parchment frame with the story text
tests.name: IntroScreen styled shows the intro dialog as a centered parchment frame with the story text
tests.title: shows the intro dialog as a centered parchment frame with the story text
tests.scenario: Given the IntroScreen is rendered, when the parchment dialog frame is queried, then it has the sf-frame-parchment and sf-dialog classes and contains 'You decide.'
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/introScreen.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

tests.id: introScreen.test.tsx::IntroScreen styled::calls onBegin exactly once when the Begin button is clicked
tests.name: IntroScreen styled calls onBegin exactly once when the Begin button is clicked
tests.title: calls onBegin exactly once when the Begin button is clicked
tests.scenario: Given the IntroScreen is rendered with an onBegin callback, when the 'Begin' button is clicked, then the callback is invoked exactly once
tests.command: cd game/frontend && npx vitest run tests/introScreen.test.tsx --testTimeout=10000

units.title: Verify: GameLayout centered story dialog unit tests
Verify: StoryPanel dialog readability unit tests

tests.name: tests/storyPanelReadable.test.tsx > StoryPanel dialog readability > gives the panel root the story-content class without the h-full and text-sm classes
tests.title: StoryPanel root has story-content and not h-full + text-sm
tests.scenario: Given a dialogue node with choices A and B, when StoryPanel renders, then the root has story-content and not the h-full/text-sm pair

tests.name: tests/storyPanelReadable.test.tsx > StoryPanel dialog readability > renders the speaker as a font-pixel heading inside the Dialogue region
tests.title: Speaker heading 'boy' uses font-pixel inside the Dialogue region
tests.scenario: Given a dialogue node spoken by boy, when StoryPanel renders, then the heading named boy carries font-pixel

tests.name: tests/storyPanelReadable.test.tsx > StoryPanel dialog readability > renders every choice button full width
tests.title: Choice buttons A and B are full width
tests.scenario: Given choices A and B, when StoryPanel renders, then both buttons carry w-full

tests.name: tests/storyPanelDialogue.test.tsx > StoryPanel dialogue card > gives the panel root the sf-frame-panel class
tests.title: StoryPanel root carries sf-frame-panel (existing test, conflicts with the story-content change)
tests.scenario: Given any StoryPanel render, when inspecting the root element, then it carries sf-frame-panel
tests.detail: Root is 'story-content flex flex-col gap-sf-3' (StoryPanel.tsx:15), not sf-frame-panel. The readability change replaced the class; the stale assertion at storyPanelDialogue.test.tsx:96 must be reconciled by its owner. Not edited here to avoid changing an expected value.

units.failure: Verify tests failed (1): tests/storyPanelDialogue.test.tsx > StoryPanel dialogue card > gives the panel root the sf-frame-panel class
